data.title: Victory Chests | Dungeon Defenders II Wiki | Fandom
data.description: These chests appear after you have defeated all waves in a map and reward you with bonus loot. There are four different rarities of chests: Powerful (Green), Epic (Blue), Mythical (Purple), and Legendary (Orange). Each chest contains one piece of loot associated with its rarity and large amounts of gold. All of the items you get from victory chests stay within the iPWR range you're currently ...

data.title: Dungeon Defenders II Gear & Shards | Shapes
data.description: Loot Tiers and Quality Rarity Equipment in Etheria is categorized by a color-coded rarity system that determines the number of secondary stats and Shard slots available. Items progress from Worn and Common to Powerful, Epic, Mythical, and Legendary, with the latter providing the highest base stats and maximum slot capacity.

data.title: Quality - Dungeon Defenders Wiki
data.description: Quality is a property of all equipment in Dungeon Defenders, including weapons, accessories, armor, and pets. It may refer to the item's base quality or tier which is usually the prefix in its name. A broader definition is, "the bias of how high something rolls within its possible range" (Moose). This depends on the map / challenge, difficulty, game mode and the Hardcore / Ruthless toggle.
